purpose: Teach: 茎/世俗/パラダイム/フェミニズム/中南米/遠距離/金星/生死

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、植物の茎の構造研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on plant stem structure, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm observation, genuinely curious. Open tone, steady eye contact. Not checking off a list — asking as someone who actually followed the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、世俗主義の歴史比較を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the historical comparison of secularism.
lines.style: Straightforward, slightly defensive. Quick acknowledgment that masks the gap between what was asked and what he studied. A small, almost apologetic smile.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、科学のパラダイム転換を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper examined paradigm shifts in science, I believe?
lines.style: Gentle rephrasing, not accusatory. Warm tone that suggests she's noticing something but not pressing. Patient curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、第二波フェミニズムの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually researched second-wave feminism.
lines.style: Quieter this time. A beat of acknowledgment that another mismatch has happened. The 'actually' carries a soft, self-aware embarrassment.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 中南米の独立運動を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And Latin American independence movements — that was your focus?
lines.style: Still warm but now with a knowing patience. Not testing him. Giving him space to notice the pattern himself. Clear and direct.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、遠距離恋愛の維持要因を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No — I wrote about the factors that sustain long-distance relationships.
lines.style: Quieter admission. The pattern is now undeniable. A small tremor under the surface — something beneath the mismatch that matters to him personally.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、金星探査の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So your paper covered the history of Venus exploration?
lines.style: Softer now. Not pressing. An opening, not an interrogation. Giving him one more chance to acknowledge what's really happening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、生死をめぐる医療倫理を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I researched medical ethics surrounding life and death.
lines.style: Quietest yet. A confession more than a statement. The words land carefully. Honesty finally breaking through the deflection, fragile and real.
